    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bad={(i,w-1-j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=g[i][w-1-j]}
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):

    return g
